{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column
print("Original revenue values (first 10):", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for commas
print("Revenue contains commas?", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# Also check for the QA orders
print("Number of rows with revenue 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
